# KrishiConnect

> KrishiConnect is a farmer-to-consumer marketplace that connects customers directly with farmers and helps users discover fresh farm products.

## Main Pages

- [Marketplace](https://www.kisandirect.online/): Browse fresh farm products available from farmers.
- [Login](https://www.kisandirect.online/login): Sign in to a KrishiConnect account.
- [Register](https://www.kisandirect.online/register): Create a KrishiConnect account.

## About

KrishiConnect provides an online marketplace connecting consumers and farmers.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://www.kisandirect.online/): Main KrishiConnect marketplace.
